name: Round-tailed Ground Squirrel
desc: Round-tailed Ground Squirrel (Xerospermophilus tereticaudus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The round-tailed ground squirrel, known as "Ardillón cola redonda" in Spanish, live in the desert of the Southwestern United States and Northwestern Mexico.
